gate_b4_0_investigation.executed_tool_path: COMPLETED, DEGRADED, CACHED, REFUSED (council/approval/tool), FAILED — all emit structured <rig-tool-outcome> via handle_tool_response → derive_agent_outcome

gate_b4_6_bridge_conversation_parity.proven: Same ToolRuntimeResult input → same derive_agent_outcome output on all governance-significant fields (schema_version, tool_name, tool_call_id, status, answer_kind, error_kind, refusal_code, recoverable, retryable, retryability_basis, mutation_disposition, degraded_capabilities, investigation_outcome, authority_decision, authority_source, git_summary_hash)
